topic: 日常安排与习惯 · Independent new scenario: a weekly routine with changes and reasons
grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Mia's Week: A New Routine with Changes
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思测试）。先阅读短文，注意一般现在时和频率词。然后完成8个阅读题。之后学习语法讲解并做8个语法题。最后进行口语和写作练习。所有题目答案必须来自原文。
passage: Mia is a student. She lives in a small city. On weekdays, she gets up at seven. She eats breakfast at home. She goes to school by bus. She has four classes in the morning. In the afternoon, she studies at the library. She goes home at five. On Monday, she has a piano lesson at six. On Wednesday, she plays basketball with friends. On Friday, she visits her grandmother. On weekends, she does not go to school. She usually reads books. Sometimes she goes to the park. This week is different. Her mother is sick. Mia stays home on Monday. She helps her mother. She does not have a piano lesson. She is sad, but she is also happy to help.

questions.prompt: What time does Mia get up on weekdays?
questions.explanation: 原文说 'She gets up at seven.'，所以选 At seven。

questions.prompt: How does Mia go to school?
questions.explanation: 原文说 'She goes to school by bus.'，所以选 By bus。
questions.evidence: She goes to school by bus.

questions.prompt: What does Mia do on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 原文说 'On Wednesday, she plays basketball with friends.'，所以选第二项。
questions.evidence: On Wednesday, she plays basketball with friends.

questions.prompt: When does Mia visit her grandmother?
questions.explanation: 原文说 'On Friday, she visits her grandmother.'，所以选 On Friday。
questions.evidence: On Friday, she visits her grandmother.

questions.prompt: What does Mia usually do on weekends?
questions.explanation: 原文说 'She usually reads books.'，所以选 She reads books。
原文说 'She goes home at five.'，所以填 five。
原文说 'Her mother is sick.'，所以填 sick。

questions.prompt: Does Mia have a piano lesson this Monday?
questions.explanation: 原文说 'She does not have a piano lesson.'，所以选 No, she does not。
questions.evidence: She does not have a piano lesson.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词与时间频率表达
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，实义动词用原形，例如：I go, you play, we study, they read。否定形式用 do not (don't) + 动词原形，例如：I do not go, they don't play。疑问形式用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形？例如：Do you like apples? 时间表达常用 at + 时间点（at seven），on + 星期/日期（on Monday），频率词如 usually（通常）、sometimes（有时）放在动词前或句首。注意：主语是第三人称单数（he/she/it）时，动词要加 -s/-es，例如：She usually reads books.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 go。
questions.evidence: 主语 I 后用动词原形。

questions.explanation: 主语是 They，动词用原形 play。
questions.evidence: 主语 They 后用动词原形。

questions.prompt: We ______ not watch TV in the morning.
questions.explanation: 主语是 We，否定用 do not + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: 主语 We 的否定用 do not。

questions.explanation: 主语是 you，疑问句用 Do 开头。
questions.evidence: 主语 you 的疑问用 Do。

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 get。
questions.evidence: 主语 I 后用动词原形。

questions.prompt: They ______ to the park on Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，动词用原形 go。
questions.evidence: 主语 They 后用动词原形。

questions.explanation: 主语是 We，否定用 do not + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: 主语 We 的否定用 do not。

questions.explanation: 主语是 they，疑问句用 Do 开头。
questions.evidence: 主语 they 的疑问用 Do。
